main_text.p: cationem nostram, primùm Deo seruientes, deinde verò alios aliis secundùm Deum: & vbi singulari ac communi opera, separata & con- iuncta, ad vnum illum finem supernæ vocatio- nis, tanquam vnius domini seruos, & domesti- cos vnius domus, oportet contendere.

Quid? quòd non solùm vnitas, sed etiam in hac vnitate nostra membrorum & actionum omnium proportio eadem voce imperatur? Ex qua id sequitur boni, quòd neq. à se ipso quis- quam diuersus sit in via Domini, neque à suis fratribus, neque à Domino; sed constanter & totus Domino suo fratribusque suis adhæreat, & sequatur Dominum cum fratrum corona re- ligiosissimè. Sed de hac re in Psalmum antece- dentem iam satis diximus. Deus ille, qui dat velle & perficere pro bona voluntate sua, gra- tiosè admoueat paternam manum, vt per eam toto corpore, animo, & mente sanctificemur, & huic officio incumbamus communionis no- stræ in timore ipsius.

Postquam verò quænam hæc communio fit audiuimus; tempus est vt ex Dauide cognosca- mus quid de ea prædicari possit. Hanc igitur communionē duobus nominibus Psaltes con- celebrauit, dicens: Bonum & amœnum esse hanc communionem cœli. page.notes: The left and right edges carry faint stray marks and cut-off letters, which are the neighbouring page or show-through and are left out. The "Quid?" line opens with a stray dash at the margin, which is not transcribed. Long s is normalised to s, and u/v and i/j are normalised as the rules require; the running head "SECVNDA" is read as SECUNDA. "Psalmum", "Psaltes" and "Psalmum" have been normalised to Psalmum and Psaltes. The words "communionē" and "neq." are copied as printed. The reading "cum fratrum corona" is a little uncertain, as the scan is soft at that point.
